messages:
nina: heads-up, dropped a new prototype for Prompt Sets > Eval Runs focused on auditability and contrast modes. Moves approval into toolbar and adds an "audit" breadcrumb when approvals happen (links to change log). figma: https://figma.com/file/audit-branch
omar: Love the audit breadcrumb idea. One question: can the change-log link include an export to CSV button for compliance teams?
lucy: Export sounds useful. Also copy nit: breadcrumb label should be 'Approval history' rather than 'Audit' to be clearer to non-security folks.
ben: Accessibility: high-contrast and colorblind palette options need to be explicit toggles. The green/red chips we use for pass/fail fail WCAG for some palettes. Suggest adding patterns/icons next to color chips (check/x) and an ARIA description that reads 'Status: Regression' for SRs.
a11y-bot: a11y recs: 1) Provide a11y theme toggle stored per user. 2) Ensure status chips have text alternatives (aria-label) and not rely on color alone. 3) When approval happens, emit a polite aria-live message: 'Approved 4 runs. Undo available.' 4) Announce audit breadcrumb when it appears: 'Approval history updated, 4 new entries.'
nina: Good. On mobile the two-column preview stacks and the toolbar becomes a sticky bottom bar. Need to confirm keyboard and SR behavior on mobile Safari/Android. Any suggestions?
omar: For mobile sticky bar, ensure it does not obscure content. Add a 'toolbar height' CSS variable and focus jump when toast appears. Also make tap targets 44px min.
lucy: Microcopy for the approval modal: Current 'Approve X runs?' -> Proposed: 'Approve X runs and record in project history? Approved results will be marked as final; only project admins can reverse this action.' Add a link 'Who can reverse' to docs.
ben: Security ask: can the change-log show actor identity and timestamp? Need to include user email hash for compliance. Also include API webhook so downstream systems can be notified on approvals.
nina: I'll add actor + timestamp to the breadcrumb detail and add a 'Notify via webhook' setting in project settings. For the modal, adding the explicit admin reversal line and docs link. Undo window proposal: 15s with undo button in toast. Thoughts?
a11y-bot: announce undo result: 'Undo complete. 3 runs unapproved.' Ensure focus returns to the approve toolbar button after undo. Also ensure ESC closes the modal and restores previous focus.
omar: Visual nit: when in high-contrast mode, use solid 2px border on chips instead of drop shadow so it reads in inverted color schemes. Also increase contrast of focus rings.
lucy: One more UX point: offline reviewers. If someone approves while another reviewer is offline, the audit breadcrumb should show 'Approved by Nina (offline at approval time)'? Might be confusing. Better to show the actor and local time only.
ben: For export CSV include columns: run_id, prompt_set_id, approver, approver_email_hash, timestamp, prior_state, new_state, note.
nina: Plan: implement approval history breadcrumb with link to expanded change-log (CSV export), add high-contrast & colorblind patterns, per-user theme toggle, mobile sticky toolbar safe area, 15s undo toast with SR announcements, modal copy update with admin reversal note + docs link, and webhook setting. I'll push an updated prototype and add a short a11y checklist for eng (focus order, aria-live messages, aria-labels for chips, keyboard scoping).
omar: I'll review the prototype for mobile breakpoints. lucy: I'll run a quick NVDA/VoiceOver pass once updated. ben: I'll draft the CSV schema and webhook spec for infra. nina: thanks all 60a will post new figma link by EOD.
